description: Chord detection on audio: chord_spans[{chord, start, end, start_beat, end_beat, confidence}], chords{"<beat>": "Am7"}, bpm, beats_per_bar, beat_map. Default = the deep ACE detector (GPU-backed, a CPU chroma detector is the automatic fallback); deep:false forces the fast CPU detector. Pass audio_key (an upload) or audio_url (a result URL from another job as returned, or any public https URL). Up to 10 minutes of audio is analyzed. Works best on a harmonic stem (piano/guitar/bass) or a clean mix. Synchronous (~5–30 s). Cancel: not applicable — the result is returned in the submit response; the job is already finished.

audio_key.description: R2 ingest key of an uploaded audio file (from doseedo_get_upload_url / POST /api/upload/r2/ingest-url; starts with "ingest/"). Provide this or audio_url.

audio_url.description: https URL of the audio (a doseedo result URL as returned, or any public URL). Alternative to audio_key.

deep.description: true (default) = deep ACE detector; false = fast CPU chroma detector.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Any unique string for THIS request (e.g. a UUID). Re-sending the same call with the same key after a timeout returns the same job instead of starting a second one.

name: doseedo_detect_chords
